feed.summary: OpenAI has publicly countered Apple's lawsuit, which accuses the ChatGPT developer of stealing intellectual property to support its entry into the consumer electronics market. feed.title: OpenAI Called Appleâs Lawsuit âOddly Personal.â Apple Says the Real Issue Is Stolen Secrets

feed.title: India Eyes More Tax Breaks for Electronics in Win For Apple
authors: Abhijit Roy Chowdhury and Sankalp Phartiyal
feed.summary: India plans to extend tax breaks for foreign firms supplying machinery to local electronics manufacturers, including companies like Apple Inc. and Google. This move, which involves amendments to the Income Tax Act, will prolong tax exemptions for contract manufacturers until 2041, benefiting the production of mobile phones, laptops, tablets, and servers. The initiative is set to bolster domestic electronics manufacturing efforts.

feed.title: Micron's 85% Gross Margin Tops Meta, Microsoft, and Google - Here's Why It Could Climb Even Higher
feed.summary: Micron Technology has achieved an 85% gross margin, surpassing software giants like Meta, Microsoft, and Alphabet, largely due to the high demand and limited supply of advanced memory chips essential for AI infrastructure. This remarkable shift in profitability for a hardware manufacturer, which previously faced negative margins, is driven by AI-related spending and the bottleneck in memory production controlled by only three companies. While memory is historically cyclical, current industry forecasts suggest that tight HBM supply and strong pricing power for Micron could continue well into 2027 or even 2028.
